# Nuevo Automations

> Nuevo Automations (Nuevo Automations FZE LLC) is a marketing agency registered in Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone, United Arab Emirates, founded by Nawaf Allahham. It focuses on premium wellness and supplement brands selling online in the UAE, running Meta (Instagram and Facebook) click-to-WhatsApp ads that send buyers to a WhatsApp chat instead of a landing page, and sells M2S (Message to Sale): an AI sales assistant that replies on WhatsApp in English or Arabic, closes the sale in the chat, follows up on abandoned carts, unpaid payment links and quiet leads, and sends a monthly results report.

Key facts:
- Serves businesses across the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the other emirates), in English and Arabic.
- M2S runs on the client's own WhatsApp number and on OrcaFlo, a WhatsApp AI platform Nuevo Automations built and runs itself.
- The AI never invents prices or products; anything it can't answer is handed to the client's team with a chat summary.
- Pricing: one fixed monthly fee, quoted in writing after a free 30-minute audit. No public price list. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta and is not part of the fee.
- No guaranteed results. Partners report 50–60% more revenue from the same traffic after full rollout, with no extra headcount, and the best return on ad spend seen, on client Khaleej ParaPharma, is 30x, not a typical result; individual results vary. Clients get a monthly M2S Results report showing conversations, orders, revenue and what follow-ups recovered.
- Peak Labs (supplements, UAE) reports a 90x faster first reply, 53% more orders a month and 74% of chats handled without a person (figures as of October 2026).

## What Is M2S? Message-to-Sale Explained | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/m2s/

M2S turns ad messages into sales: click-to-WhatsApp ads, instant AI replies in English and Arabic, in-chat checkout, follow-ups and a monthly report.

M2S (Message to Sale) is a done-for-you service from Nuevo Automations, a Sharjah-registered marketing agency. We run Meta click-to-WhatsApp ads and Google search ads, and an AI sales assistant replies to every message in seconds in English or Arabic, takes the order or booking in the chat, follows up with abandoned carts, unpaid links and leads that went silent, and reports the results every month.

Q: Who is M2S for?
A: UAE businesses that sell through conversations: online stores, clinics, salons and spas, real estate, education and training, and restaurants. It suits businesses that already run Meta or Google ads, or are ready to, and want more of those messages to turn into sales.

Q: Do I keep my own WhatsApp number?
A: Yes. The AI sales assistant runs on your own WhatsApp number, and your team can keep using the WhatsApp app to step in at any time.

Q: What does the M2S assistant do when it doesn't know an answer?
A: It never invents prices or products. Anything it can't answer goes straight to your team with an instant WhatsApp alert and a summary of the chat.

Q: How is M2S priced?
A: One fixed monthly fee, based on your ad budget, your channels and how many products or services we load, quoted in writing after a free 30-minute audit. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta or Google.

Q: How do I know M2S is working?
A: Every chat is tagged with the ad it came from, and you get a monthly M2S Results report: conversations, orders, revenue, reply speed and the revenue recovered by follow-ups.

## WhatsApp Automation in Dubai & UAE, Business API | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/whatsapp-automation-uae/

WhatsApp Business API automation in the UAE on your own number: the 24-hour reply window, Meta-approved templates, opt-in and opt-out, handled for you.

WhatsApp automation means replying to, qualifying and following up with customers on WhatsApp by software rather than by hand. For a business, it runs on the official WhatsApp Business API, which allows an AI assistant, team inboxes and Meta-approved message templates. Messages outside the 24-hour customer-service window must use those templates, and customers must be able to opt out. We set this up for brands in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the other emirates, on their own number.

Q: Do I lose my WhatsApp chat history when moving to the API?
A: Your customers keep the same number and their side of the conversation. During the audit we check your current setup and explain what moves over before anything changes.

Q: Can my team still use the WhatsApp app?
A: Yes. M2S runs on the same number through the official API, and your team can still open the WhatsApp app on it to read and reply to any chat.

Q: What is the 24-hour customer-service window?
A: After a customer's last message, a business can reply freely for 24 hours. After that, it can only restart the conversation with a message template Meta has approved. We write and set those up for you.

Q: How do customers opt out of follow-ups?
A: They just say stop. Anyone who does is never messaged again, follow-ups never go out at night, and each customer gets at most one sequence per week.

Q: Will my click-to-WhatsApp ads open chats on this number?
A: Yes. The ads we run open chats on your own number, each tagged with the ad that started it, and sales made in the chat are reported back to Meta.

Instagram DM automation in Dubai: ads that open DMs or WhatsApp, comments and story replies turned into DMs, and the sale moved to WhatsApp to pay.

Instagram DM automation means answering direct messages, story replies and post comments automatically, usually with an AI assistant. It covers ads that open a DM, comments that trigger a private reply, and replies to stories. For businesses that close sales on WhatsApp, the DM can hand the customer over to WhatsApp for the payment link or booking.

Q: Can it reply to Instagram comments with a private message?
A: Yes. When someone comments a question like "price?" on a post or reel, the assistant sends them a private DM with the answer.

Q: Should my ads open Instagram DMs or WhatsApp?
A: It depends on the audience and the product. DMs suit people still browsing; WhatsApp suits people ready to buy, because checkout runs there. We often test both and compare sales in the monthly report.

Q: Why move the conversation to WhatsApp?
A: Because the payment link, cash-on-delivery order, booking and follow-ups run on WhatsApp in M2S. The assistant offers the move at the buying point and carries the context across.

Q: Does it reply to story replies?
A: Yes. Replies and questions on your stories are answered in the DM in seconds, in English or Arabic.

## AI Chatbot Development in Dubai & UAE, for Sales | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/ai-chatbot-development-uae/

How we build AI sales chatbots in the UAE: trained on your products, prices and policies, with guardrails, English and Arabic, and testing before launch.

An AI sales chatbot is a chat assistant that answers buying questions, recommends products and closes the sale in the conversation. A well-built one works only from the business's own catalogue, prices and policies, refuses to make anything up, replies in the customer's language, and passes anything it cannot answer to a person with a summary of the chat. We build and run these chatbots for brands in Dubai and across the UAE, on WhatsApp and website chat, in English and Arabic.

Q: What do you need from us to build the chatbot?
A: Your products or services, prices, delivery or booking terms, opening hours and policies such as returns. We turn that into the information the assistant answers from and check it with you.

Q: Can it make up a price or a discount?
A: No. It only quotes prices from your list. If something isn't there, it tells the customer a colleague will confirm and sends your team a chat summary.

Q: How do you test the chatbot before launch?
A: We run real questions from your inbox through it, in English and Arabic, check each answer against your information and fix any gaps before customers use it.

Q: Does it work on our website as well as WhatsApp?
A: Yes. The same assistant can run on WhatsApp and your website chat, from the same products, prices and policies.

## CRM Automation & Sales Pipeline, UAE | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/crm-automation-uae/

A WhatsApp sales pipeline for UAE businesses: stages from new lead to ordered, lead routing, instant staff alerts and follow-up rules your team can see.

CRM automation is software keeping your customer records and sales stages up to date without manual entry. In M2S, every WhatsApp chat becomes a lead that moves through four stages as the AI assistant talks to the customer: New lead, Qualified, Checkout started and Ordered, with staff alerts and follow-up rules attached to each.

Q: What are the pipeline stages?
A: New lead, Qualified, Checkout started and Ordered. Leads move between them automatically as the assistant talks to the customer, and your team can see each lead's stage.

Q: How does the pipeline route leads to the right person?
A: By rules we agree with you, such as product, area, language or the ad that started the chat. The chosen person gets a WhatsApp alert with a summary of the chat.

Q: Do we have to replace our current CRM?
A: No. M2S has its own pipeline, and where you already use a CRM we can send leads and stage changes to it as well.

Q: When do pipeline follow-ups stop?
A: As soon as the customer replies or buys, or says stop. None go out at night, and no customer gets more than one sequence a week.

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/ai-receptionist-uae/

AI receptionist for UAE service businesses: checks availability, books, reschedules and cancels on WhatsApp, takes deposits and sends reminders.

An AI receptionist is an assistant that handles appointment requests in chat the way a front desk would. It reads your calendar's free times, offers slots, books them, reschedules or cancels when asked, takes a deposit if you require one and sends reminders before the visit. Questions outside its information go to a person.

Q: Which calendar does it book into?
A: It reads free times from your calendar and writes confirmed bookings back to it. We connect your calendar during setup and check the rules for each service's length.

Q: Can customers reschedule or cancel by themselves?
A: Yes. They ask in the chat, the assistant offers free times or cancels under your policy, and your team gets a WhatsApp alert about the change.

Q: Can it take a deposit before confirming?
A: Yes, if you want one. It sends a card payment link from your payment provider and confirms the booking once it's paid.

Q: Does it take bookings at night?
A: Yes. Requests that arrive after hours are answered in seconds and booked into real free times, and your team gets a WhatsApp alert for each new booking.

For M2S it means products and prices come in from your store or sheet, free times from your calendar, and payment confirmations from your payment provider, while orders, leads and bookings go back out without anyone copying them.

Q: Are integrations priced separately?

Q: What happens if an integration breaks?

## WhatsApp & Meta Ads Guides for UAE Brands | Nuevo Automations

## WhatsApp Business API Pricing in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-uae/

How Meta charges for WhatsApp Business API messages in the UAE in 2026: per-message billing, the October 2026 service-message change and free ad windows.

Since 1 July 2025, Meta bills the WhatsApp Business API per delivered message, not per conversation. The price depends on the message category (marketing, utility, authentication or service) and on the country code of the customer who receives it. The UAE is its own market on Meta's rate card. From 1 October 2026, each business number gets 1,000 free service messages a month and pays for service messages beyond that. Chats that start from a click-to-WhatsApp ad open a free entry point window in which Meta doesn't charge for messages.

Q: Is the WhatsApp Business app free?
A: Yes. The free WhatsApp Business app on your phone has no per-message charges. Per-message pricing applies to the WhatsApp Business API (the Business Platform), which you need for an AI assistant, team inboxes, ad tracking and scheduled follow-ups.

Q: Do I pay when a customer messages my business?
A: No. Meta only charges for messages your business sends that are delivered. Messages customers send you are free.

Q: Which country's rate applies to a UAE business?
A: The rate of the country code of the customer receiving the message. Messages to +971 numbers use the UAE rate; messages to customers abroad use their country's rate.

Q: Are replies to customers still free after October 2026?
A: Each business number gets 1,000 free service messages a month. Beyond that, service messages are charged at Meta's published rate, except for eligible government and non-profit accounts.

Q: How long is the free window after a click-to-WhatsApp ad?
A: Meta's developer documentation says the free entry point window can stay open for up to 7 days once you reply within 24 hours; its marketing pages say 72 hours. During it, Meta doesn't charge for template or service messages to that customer.

## Click-to-WhatsApp Ads: A Guide for UAE Brands | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/click-to-whatsapp-ads/

How click-to-WhatsApp ads work on Instagram and Facebook, when they beat a landing page, how to set them up and how to report the sales they make.

A click-to-WhatsApp ad is an Instagram or Facebook ad whose button opens a WhatsApp chat with your business, often with a pre-filled first message. It works best when buyers have questions before they pay, such as dosage, delivery or authenticity, which is common for premium wellness products in the UAE. The ad only starts the conversation: the sale depends on replying within seconds and on reporting chat sales back to Meta so it can find more buyers.

Q: Do click-to-WhatsApp ads work on Instagram?
A: Yes. They run on Instagram, Facebook and Messenger placements. Tapping the button opens WhatsApp on the buyer's phone with your business number.

Q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API for click-to-WhatsApp ads?
A: No, the ads can open chats on the WhatsApp Business app. You need the API to reply automatically, tag each chat with its ad, run follow-ups and report sales back to Meta.

Q: Which campaign objective should I use?
A: Engagement, Leads or Sales can all use WhatsApp as the conversion location. Once you send sales back through the Conversions API, a Sales objective lets Meta optimise for buyers rather than for conversations.

Q: How fast do I need to reply?
A: As fast as possible, ideally within seconds. The buyer has just tapped the ad and has WhatsApp open; a reply hours later usually loses the sale.

## Advertising Supplements in the UAE: 2026 Rules | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/advertising-supplements-uae/

Meta's rules for supplement ads, the UAE's November 2026 medical-advertising clarification and the influencer ban, and how to keep WhatsApp sales chats compliant.

On Meta, ads for dietary, health and herbal supplements must target people aged 18 or over, can't use before-and-after images or make people feel bad about their bodies, and can't promise a specific result in a set time. In the UAE, the Emirates Drug Establishment said on 18 November 2026 that every advertisement for a medical product needs its approval before it runs, on any channel including social media, and that influencers may not promote medical products. Supplements have their own registration and approval routes, which differ by product and emirate, so check your product's classification with the regulator before you advertise.

Q: Can I target supplement ads to under-18s on Instagram?
A: No. Meta requires ads for dietary, health and herbal supplements, and weight-loss products, to target people aged 18 or over.

Q: Do supplement ads in the UAE need approval?
A: Often, yes. Medical product ads need Emirates Drug Establishment approval before they run, and supplements have their own registration and approval routes that can differ by emirate. Check your product's classification with the regulator.

Q: Can influencers promote supplements in the UAE?
A: Influencers may not promote medical products, under the Emirates Drug Establishment's November 2026 clarification. Whether a supplement falls under that depends on its classification, and paid creators also need the UAE Media Council's advertiser permit.

Q: Are before-and-after photos allowed in Meta wellness ads?
A: No. Meta lists before-and-after weight-loss photos as an example of content that creates negative self-perception, which its health and wellness standards don't allow.

## WhatsApp Abandoned Cart Recovery: How It Works | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-abandoned-cart-recovery/

How to recover abandoned carts on WhatsApp: what you need, when to send, what to write in English and Arabic, what it costs and how to measure it.

WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery means sending an approved WhatsApp template to a shopper who left items in their cart, with a way to finish the order. You need the WhatsApp Business API, the shopper's number and consent from checkout, a Meta-approved marketing template, and a link from your store that tells the system a cart was left. Send the first reminder within about an hour, at most one more the next day, stop the moment they reply or buy, and never at night.

Q: Can I send cart reminders from the free WhatsApp Business app?
A: Not automatically. Automated reminders need the WhatsApp Business API and a Meta-approved template.

Q: Is an abandoned-cart message marketing or utility?
A: Meta treats cart reminders as marketing messages, so they need a marketing template and are charged at the marketing rate.

Q: How many reminders should I send?
A: One within about an hour, and at most one more the next day. Stop as soon as the shopper replies, buys or asks you to stop.

Q: Do I need consent to message shoppers on WhatsApp?
A: Yes. WhatsApp requires opt-in. Ask for the number at checkout with a clear statement that you'll message them about their order, and honour every stop request.

## How to Track Sales From WhatsApp Ads (Real ROAS) | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/track-whatsapp-ad-sales/

Why Ads Manager shows conversations, not sales, for WhatsApp ads, and how to send chat sales back to Meta with the Conversions API to see real return on ad spend.

Ads Manager can't see what happens inside a WhatsApp chat, so for click-to-WhatsApp ads it reports conversations started, not sales. To see real return on ad spend, capture the click ID WhatsApp passes with each chat that starts from an ad, and when that chat turns into an order, send a Purchase event with the order value to Meta's Conversions API. Meta then attributes the sale to the ad and can optimise for buyers instead of chatters.

Q: Can Meta Pixel track WhatsApp sales?
A: No. The pixel only runs on web pages. Sales made inside WhatsApp chats need to be sent to Meta through the Conversions API, tied to the ad's click ID.

Q: What is ctwa_clid?
A: It's the click ID the WhatsApp Business API passes with the first message of a chat that started from a click-to-WhatsApp ad. Sending it back with a Purchase event lets Meta attribute the sale to that ad.

Q: Should I optimise click-to-WhatsApp ads for conversations or sales?
A: For sales, once purchases are reaching Meta. Optimising for conversations teaches Meta to find people who start chats, not people who buy.

Q: Is Meta's reported ROAS accurate?
A: It's an estimate based on its attribution window and modelling. Compare it every month with your store's own delivered orders.

## WhatsApp Chatbot Cost in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-chatbot-cost-uae/

What a WhatsApp chatbot really costs a UAE business in 2026: Meta's message fees, platform subscriptions like Wati and Respond.io, AI credits and setup.

A WhatsApp chatbot in the UAE has four costs. First, Meta's per-message fees on the WhatsApp Business Platform, priced by message type at the UAE rate; customer messages are free, and chats from click-to-WhatsApp ads open a free window. Second, a platform subscription: on their own pricing pages in November 2026, Wati starts at $59 a month (billed annually), Respond.io at $79 a month (annually) or $99 monthly, Gallabox at AED 412 a month (annually), and Twilio charges $0.005 per message with no subscription. Third, AI usage, usually as platform AI credits. Fourth, setup: connecting your number, templates, store integration and training the bot.

Q: Is there a free WhatsApp chatbot?
A: The free WhatsApp Business app has quick replies and a greeting message but no real chatbot or AI. A chatbot needs the WhatsApp Business API, which means Meta's per-message fees plus a platform or developer.

Q: What is the cheapest way to run a WhatsApp chatbot?
A: Building directly on the API with a provider like Twilio has no subscription ($0.005 a message plus Meta's fees) but needs a developer. For most small brands, a platform's entry plan is cheaper overall once you count build and maintenance time.

Q: Do WhatsApp platforms charge more than Meta for messages?
A: Some do. Respond.io says it doesn't mark up Meta's rates. Interakt and Gallabox list markup discounts on enterprise plans, which implies a markup on lower plans. Wati shows its rates only after login. Ask each provider in writing.

Q: Can a WhatsApp chatbot reply in Arabic?
A: Yes. AI-based bots on the main platforms can reply in Arabic and English. Check how well the bot handles Gulf dialect and mixed Arabic-English messages before you commit.

Q: Does the chatbot cost more if customers come from ads?
A: Usually less. Chats that start from a click-to-WhatsApp ad on a phone open Meta's free entry point window when you reply within 24 hours, so Meta doesn't charge for messages to that customer for up to 7 days.

## Meta Ads for E-commerce Brands in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/meta-ads-ecommerce-uae/

Running Meta ads for an online store in the UAE in 2026: sales campaigns, Conversions API, ad rules for health products, VAT and the advertiser permit.

For a UAE online store, Meta ads in 2026 mean Advantage+ sales campaigns (the renamed Advantage+ shopping campaigns) or manual sales campaigns, optimised on purchases tracked through the Meta pixel plus the Conversions API. Health and supplement ads must target people 18 or older and avoid miracle claims. Meta charges 5% UAE VAT on ad spend unless you add your 15-digit tax registration number. Influencers and creators who promote products in the UAE need an advertiser permit from the National Media Authority, enforced from early 2026, and brands should check the permit before paying them.

Q: What happened to Advantage+ shopping campaigns?
A: Meta renamed them Advantage+ sales campaigns in February 2025 and merged them into the Sales objective setup. Turning off certain automated settings makes it a manual sales campaign.

Q: Do I need the Conversions API if I have the Meta pixel?
A: It's strongly recommended. The pixel misses purchases blocked by browsers and privacy settings; the Conversions API sends them from your server or store. Meta charges nothing for it when set up through Events Manager.

Q: Do I pay VAT on Facebook and Instagram ads in the UAE?
A: Meta charges 5% VAT to UAE ad accounts without a tax registration number. VAT-registered businesses can add their 15-digit TRN in payment settings; check with your accountant how to account for it.

Q: Do influencers in the UAE need a licence to promote my products?
A: Yes. Since early 2026, people promoting products on social media in the UAE need an advertiser permit from the National Media Authority. Check the permit before you pay and put the number in the contract.

Q: Can I target under-18s with supplement ads?
A: No. Meta requires health, diet, weight-loss and supplement ads to target people 18 or older.

Respond.io vs Wati compared for UAE brands in 2026: prices, users, AI credits, WhatsApp fee markups, channels, Shopify and CRM integrations.

## How to Take Payments on WhatsApp in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-payment-links-uae/

WhatsApp Pay isn't live in the UAE, so brands sell in the chat with payment links. Fees for Stripe, Ziina, Telr and others, plus Tabby and Tamara.

WhatsApp's built-in payments, including the "Review and Pay" order message, are only documented by Meta for India, Brazil and Singapore, not the UAE. UAE businesses take payment in WhatsApp by sending a payment link from their own provider: Stripe charges 2.9% plus AED 1 for domestic cards, Ziina lists 2.6% plus AED 1 on its business page, and Telr has monthly plans with unlimited payment links. Tabby and Tamara can also create payment links, though their documentation describes sending them by SMS or email. The customer taps the link, pays on the provider's page, and your team or AI confirms the order in the chat.

Q: Is WhatsApp Pay available in the UAE?
A: Not for businesses, as of November 2026. Meta documents WhatsApp's native business payments only for India, Brazil and Singapore. UAE businesses send a payment link from their own provider instead.

Q: What is the cheapest way to take a payment in WhatsApp?
A: It depends on volume. Stripe has no monthly fee and charges 2.9% plus AED 1 for domestic cards. Telr's higher-volume plans go down to 2.25% plus AED 0.50 with no monthly fee. Compare the total on your real monthly sales, including international cards.

Q: Can I send a Tabby or Tamara link on WhatsApp?
A: Both can create payment links, but their own documentation describes sending them by SMS or email, not WhatsApp. Some gateways offer BNPL inside links you can share in WhatsApp. Ask the provider before building it into your flow.

Q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API to send payment links?
A: No, you can paste a link in the free WhatsApp Business app. You need the API to automate it: sending links from an AI assistant, tracking which are paid, and following up on unpaid ones.

Q: Is it safe for customers to pay through a WhatsApp link?
A: Yes, when the link opens a page from a licensed payment provider on its own domain. Tell customers which provider you use, and never ask for card details inside the chat itself.

## How to Sell Supplements Online in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/sell-supplements-online-uae/

Selling supplements online in the UAE: who registers products (EDE, Dubai Municipality), e-commerce licences, Arabic rules, ad approvals and payments.

To sell supplements online in the UAE you need a trade licence that allows e-commerce (for example Dubai's eTrader or Abu Dhabi's Tajer licence, or a free zone e-commerce licence), and your products must be registered. Federally, the Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) took over medical product services from the Ministry of Health from 29 December 2025 and lists food supplements under its healthcare product marketing authorisation, which only a licensed medical warehouse can apply for. In Dubai, Dubai Municipality requires health supplements to be registered in its Montaji system before they are imported, advertised or sold. Product details and invoices must be available in Arabic, VAT is 5%, and ads for medical products need EDE approval.

Q: Do I need to register supplements before selling them online in the UAE?
A: Yes. In Dubai, Dubai Municipality requires health supplements to be registered in its Montaji system before they are sold or advertised. Federally, the Emirates Drug Establishment lists food supplements under its healthcare product marketing authorisation. Confirm which applies to your product with both.

Q: Who regulates supplements in the UAE now?
A: Medical product services, including marketing authorisations and advertising approvals, moved from the Ministry of Health and Prevention to the Emirates Drug Establishment from 29 December 2025. Dubai Municipality and other local authorities also register health supplements in their emirates.

Q: Can I sell supplements from a free zone company?
A: Free zones issue e-commerce licences, but selling directly to mainland UAE customers may need a local distributor or extra approvals, and product registration still applies. Check with your free zone and a registration agent.

Q: Can influencers promote my supplements?
A: Every creator promoting products in the UAE needs an Advertiser Permit. Since November 2026, influencers may not promote medical products, and ads for them need EDE approval. Ask EDE whether your registered supplement counts before you brief anyone.

Q: Are peptides treated as supplements in the UAE?
A: No. In July 2026 the Emirates Drug Establishment acted against sellers of unapproved peptide products and said the label "peptide" doesn't make something an approved product. Treat therapeutic peptides as medical products.

## Shopify WhatsApp Integration for UAE Stores, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/shopify-whatsapp-integration/

How to connect Shopify to WhatsApp in 2026: Shopify Messaging, Meta's official app, Zoko, Interakt, Wati and others, with prices and what each automates.

There are three ways to connect Shopify to WhatsApp in 2026. Shopify Messaging, built into Shopify, sends WhatsApp marketing campaigns and abandoned cart, checkout and browse automations, with an opt-in at checkout; in the UAE it charges US$0.10 per marketing message. Meta's official WhatsApp app for Shopify is free to install and sends order updates and abandoned cart messages, with Meta billing messages separately. Third-party apps such as Zoko, Interakt, Wati, SuperLemon and Gallabox add a shared team inbox, cash on delivery confirmation and AI chat. Shopify Inbox, Shopify's chat tool, does not connect to WhatsApp.

Q: Does Shopify have WhatsApp built in?
A: Yes, since July 2026. Shopify Messaging can send WhatsApp marketing campaigns and, since October 2026, abandoned cart, checkout and browse automations. In the UAE it costs US$0.10 per marketing message.

Q: Does Shopify Inbox work with WhatsApp?
A: No. Shopify Inbox is a chat tool for your online store; its help pages don't mention WhatsApp. For WhatsApp conversations you need Shopify Messaging for campaigns, or a WhatsApp app with an inbox.

Q: Is there a free WhatsApp app for Shopify?
A: Meta's official WhatsApp app is free to install, and Meta bills each message separately. SuperLemon also has a free plan. Every option still pays Meta's per-message fees.

Q: Are abandoned cart messages on WhatsApp utility or marketing?

## Arabic WhatsApp Chatbots: Gulf Dialect and AI, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/arabic-whatsapp-chatbot/

What makes an Arabic WhatsApp chatbot work in the UAE: Gulf dialect, Arabizi, mixed Arabic and English, right-to-left templates, and what research shows.

An Arabic WhatsApp chatbot for the UAE has to handle three kinds of writing: Gulf and Emirati dialect, Arabizi (Arabic written in Latin letters and numbers, like "7abibi"), and messages that mix Arabic and English. Published research shows AI models still do worse in Arabic dialects than in English: in the 2025 DialectalArabicMMLU benchmark, 19 open models averaged about 48% accuracy in dialects, 52% in Modern Standard Arabic and 63% in English. Templates need the right Arabic language code (such as ar_AE) and testing for right-to-left layout. The best test is to send the bot real messages from your own customers before launch.

Q: Can a WhatsApp chatbot reply in Arabic?
A: Yes. AI chatbots on the WhatsApp Business API can reply in Arabic and English. How well they handle Gulf dialect, Arabizi and mixed messages varies a lot, so test with real customer messages.

Q: What is Arabizi?
A: Arabic written in Latin letters, with numbers standing in for Arabic sounds, for example 3 for ع and 7 for ح. Many people in the UAE type this way on their phones, so a chatbot should understand it.

Q: Is AI worse in Arabic than in English?
A: On published benchmarks, yes. In the 2025 DialectalArabicMMLU study, 19 open models averaged about 63% accuracy in English, 52% in Modern Standard Arabic and 48% in Arabic dialects.

Q: Which Arabic language code should UAE templates use?
A: Meta offers several Arabic codes, including ar and ar_AE. Pick one and keep it consistent, then supply your own Arabic text; Meta doesn't translate templates.

Q: Should the chatbot reply in formal Arabic or dialect?
A: Match the customer. Formal Arabic is safe for templates and policies, but a casual question in Gulf dialect reads better with a natural, simple reply.

## WhatsApp Marketing Rules in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-marketing-rules-uae/

The rules for WhatsApp marketing in the UAE in 2026: Meta's opt-in policy, messaging limits, per-user caps, the telemarketing resolution and the PDPL.

To send WhatsApp marketing in the UAE, you need the customer's number and their opt-in, which must name your business and make clear they are agreeing to messages from you. You must honour opt-out requests made on or off WhatsApp. Messages outside the 24-hour customer service window must use Meta-approved templates, new accounts can message 250 people a day until Meta raises the limit, and Meta can cap marketing messages to people who don't engage. Under UAE law, Cabinet Resolution No. 56 of 2024 defines telemarketing to include marketing messages through social media applications, and the data protection law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) requires consent to process personal data, with some exceptions.

Q: Is WhatsApp marketing legal in the UAE?
A: Yes, with consent. Meta requires an opt-in that names your business, and UAE law requires consent to process personal data. The 2024 telemarketing resolution's definition also covers marketing messages through social media applications, so treat its rules as applying.

Q: What counts as a valid WhatsApp opt-in?
A: Meta says the opt-in must clearly state that the person agrees to receive messages from your business and must name the business. It can be collected anywhere, such as at checkout, in a form or in the chat, and doesn't have to mention WhatsApp specifically.

Q: How many WhatsApp messages can I send per day?
A: A new business portfolio can start conversations with 250 unique people in 24 hours. Verifying your business unlocks 2,000, and Meta raises the limit to 10,000, 100,000 and then unlimited as you use it with high-quality messages.

Q: What time can I send marketing messages in the UAE?
A: Cabinet Resolution No. 56 of 2024 limits marketing calls to 9am to 6pm. It doesn't spell out hours for messages, but keeping WhatsApp marketing in that window is the safe choice.

Q: What happens if customers report my WhatsApp messages as spam?
A: Your template and number quality drops, and Meta can pause templates, block sending for 1 to 30 days, lock the account or ban it permanently. Message only people who opted in, and make it easy to stop.

## WhatsApp Business App vs API: Which One in 2026? | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-business-app-vs-api/

WhatsApp Business app vs the API in 2026: devices, broadcasts, automation, pricing, the blue tick, Meta One and coexistence (using both on one number).

The WhatsApp Business app is free, runs on one phone plus up to four linked devices (ten with multi-agent), and has quick replies, greeting messages and broadcast lists of up to 256 people who must have saved your number. The WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API) has no inbox of its own, so you use it through a platform, but it allows unlimited agents, chatbots and AI, approved templates to anyone who opted in, and integrations, with Meta charging per message. Coexistence lets one number use both: the app for one-to-one chats, the API for automation. The free blue tick is available only on the API; Meta One sells a verified badge for the app.

Q: Is the WhatsApp Business API free?
A: No. Meta charges per delivered message, by category and country, and most businesses also pay a platform for the inbox and automation. Each number gets 1,000 free service messages a month, and chats from click-to-WhatsApp ads open a free window of up to 7 days.

Q: Can I use the WhatsApp Business app and the API on the same number?
A: Yes, through Meta's coexistence feature, set up via a Meta partner. You keep chatting in the app while the API handles automation; there are limits, such as read-only broadcast lists and 20 messages a second.

Q: How many people can use one WhatsApp Business app account?
A: One phone plus up to 4 linked devices, or up to 10 devices with multi-agent. The API has no such limit; it depends on your platform.

Q: How do I get the green or blue tick on WhatsApp?
A: The free Official Business Account badge is only for API numbers with a verified business, 30 days on the platform and two-step verification. App users can get a verified badge through a paid Meta One subscription.

Q: Why can't my broadcast reach some customers?
A: In the WhatsApp Business app, broadcasts only reach people who have saved your number, up to 256 per list. To reach everyone who opted in, you need API templates or the app's paid business broadcasts where available.

## مبيعات واتساب بالذكاء الاصطناعي لعلامات المكملات في الإمارات | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/ar/

ندير إعلانات Meta وGoogle إلى واتساب لعلامات العافية والمكملات في الإمارات، ويرد M2S خلال ثوانٍ ويُتمّ البيع ويتابع. احجز تدقيقاً مجانياً لمدة 30 دقيقة.

M2S (من الرسالة إلى البيع) نظام مبيعات على واتساب: إعلانات Meta بنقرة إلى واتساب تجلب المشتري إلى المحادثة، ومساعد بالذكاء الاصطناعي مدرَّب على منتجاتك وأسعارك وسياساتك يجيب ويُتمّ الطلب برابط دفع أو بالدفع عند الاستلام، ثم يتابع السلال المتروكة وروابط الدفع غير المدفوعة والعملاء الصامتين. يعمل على رقم واتساب الخاص بك، وتحصل على تقرير شهري بالمحادثات والطلبات والإيرادات.

Q: لماذا نرسل الإعلانات إلى واتساب بدل الموقع؟
A: مشتري المكملات الغذائية يسأل قبل أن يدفع: عن المكونات والجرعة والتوصيل. صفحة الهبوط لا تجيبه، أما في واتساب فيحصل على الإجابة خلال ثوانٍ ويدفع في المحادثة نفسها.

Q: كم تكلفة M2S؟
A: رسوم شهرية ثابتة واحدة، نرسلها مكتوبة بعد التدقيق المجاني. ميزانية الإعلانات تدفعها مباشرة إلى Meta أو Google وليست ضمن رسومنا.

Q: هل أحتاج إلى رقم واتساب جديد؟
A: لا. يعمل M2S على رقمك الحالي، ويستمر فريقك في استخدام تطبيق واتساب للتدخل في أي محادثة.

Q: هل يرد المساعد بالعربية؟
A: نعم. يرد بالعربية أو الإنجليزية، باللغة التي يكتب بها العميل.

Q: ماذا يفعل المساعد إذا لم يعرف الإجابة؟
A: لا يخترع أسعاراً أو منتجات أبداً. يحوّل المحادثة إلى فريقك فوراً مع تنبيه على واتساب وملخص للمحادثة.

Q: هل تضمنون النتائج؟
A: لا. نضمن أن كل محادثة تحصل على رد خلال ثوانٍ وأن كل مشترٍ صامت يحصل على متابعة، ويُظهر التقرير الشهري ما الذي عاد من مبيعات.

## أتمتة واتساب للأعمال في الإمارات ودبي | WhatsApp API | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/ar/whatsapp-automation-uae/

أتمتة مبيعات واتساب في الإمارات على رقمك الخاص: WhatsApp Business API، نافذة الـ24 ساعة، القوالب المعتمدة، الموافقة وإيقاف الرسائل، ومساعد ذكاء اصطناعي بالعربية.

أتمتة واتساب تعني الرد على العملاء وتأهيلهم ومتابعتهم عبر برنامج بدل العمل اليدوي. للأعمال، تعمل على WhatsApp Business API الرسمية، التي تتيح مساعداً بالذكاء الاصطناعي وصندوق وارد للفريق وقوالب رسائل تعتمدها Meta. الرسائل خارج نافذة خدمة العملاء (24 ساعة) يجب أن تستخدم تلك القوالب، ويجب أن يتمكن العميل دائماً من إيقاف الرسائل.

Q: ما الفرق بين تطبيق واتساب للأعمال وWhatsApp Business API؟
A: التطبيق مجاني ويعمل على هاتف واحد مع حتى أربعة أجهزة مرتبطة، وقوائم البث فيه محدودة بـ256 جهة اتصال حفظت رقمك. أما الـAPI فيتيح عدداً غير محدود من الموظفين ومساعداً بالذكاء الاصطناعي ورسائل قوالب معتمدة لكل من وافق على استلامها، وتحاسب Meta عليه لكل رسالة.

Q: هل أحتفظ برقمي الحالي؟
A: نعم. يمكن ربط رقمك الحالي بالـAPI، ومع ميزة التعايش من Meta يستمر فريقك في استخدام تطبيق واتساب للأعمال على الرقم نفسه.

Q: كم تكلفة رسائل واتساب في الإمارات؟
A: تحاسب Meta لكل رسالة مُسلَّمة حسب الفئة (تسويق، خدمات، مصادقة، خدمة عملاء) وحسب دولة العميل، وللإمارات سعر خاص يمكن دفعه بالدرهم منذ أبريل 2026. لكل رقم 1,000 رسالة خدمة مجانية شهرياً، والمحادثات التي تبدأ من إعلان بنقرة إلى واتساب مجانية لمدة تصل إلى 7 أيام إذا رددت خلال 24 ساعة.

Q: هل يجب أن يوافق العميل قبل أن أراسله؟
A: نعم. تشترط Meta موافقة واضحة تذكر اسم نشاطك، ويجب احترام أي طلب لإيقاف الرسائل. والقانون الإماراتي لحماية البيانات الشخصية يشترط الموافقة لمعالجة البيانات مع استثناءات محددة.

Q: هل يفهم المساعد اللهجة الخليجية؟
A: يرد M2S بالعربية والإنجليزية حسب لغة العميل، ونختبره قبل الإطلاق برسائل حقيقية من عملائك، بما فيها اللهجة الخليجية والرسائل المختلطة بالعربية والإنجليزية.
